fields.title: 5. Management Statements — Recorded Only as Milestone Candidates
fields.md:
| Date | Statement | Cross-check |
|---|---|---|
| 10/14 | "Starshield is owned and controlled by the U.S. government; restrictions are set by the U.S. military and the president" | Reuters 10/15 reported an internal White House directive — consistent. However, it conflicts with the 10/24 statement |
| 10/24 | "The Ukrainian military violated Starlink's terms of service → we closed the loophole last week · we only enforced the terms" | SpaceX acknowledged that it **enforced** the restriction. Ukraine countered that "drone missions are impossible on civilian Starlink (registration system, 70–90 km/h cap)" — which service was restricted remains unconfirmed |

(Source: Section 1 table — [Reuters 10/15](https://www.internazionale.it/ultime-notizie-reuters/2026/10/16/exclusive-order-to-limit-starshield-for-ukraine-came-from-inside-white-house-sources-say) · [NBC 10/25](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/ukraine/elon-musk-spacex-closed-ukraine-starlink-loophole-limits-hit-drone-rcna605494) · [The Record 10/26](https://therecord.media/ukraine-disputes-musk-claims-of-starlink-misuse))
